bio_am: Ծնած է Վերին Ագուլիս՝ 1859-ին։ Հ.Յ. Դաշնակցութեան հիմնադիրը, զոհուեցաւ Սոֆիայի մօտ՝ ռումբի փորձի ժամանակ, 20 Մարտ 1905-ին։
bio_en: Kristapor Mikaelian was born in Upper Agulis on 18 October 1859 (old style) to poor parents and was orphaned young; after his studies he became a teacher in his native village in 1880. Drawn from cosmopolitan to national ideas, in 1881 he proposed national organisations to his Tiflis friends, and he took part in the patriotic groups of the 1880s; in 1890 he was the moving spirit of the Tiflis meeting that united the 'Young Armenia' groups into the ARF, and from 1891 the party published Droshak. Arrested in 1893, he spent a year in exile in Kishinev, from where he organised the transfer of Droshak's printing to Romania, and in 1895 he was jailed again for five months in Baku. He later planned the 1905 Yildiz attempt on Sultan Abdul Hamid; on 20 March 1905, while testing a bomb on the slopes of Mount Vitosha near Sofia, he was killed by the explosion together with his young collaborator Vram Kenderian.
